copy.blurb:
A +27.0pp gap on the Croatia side. Croatia v Ghana in FIFA World Cup 2026 is the match. The model has Croatia stronger than the market does — that's the reason this fires as a Pick rather than a Pass.

Public Elo rates Croatia 240 points higher than the other side (Croatia 1860, Ghana 1620). The match model's logistic translates that Elo gap directly into a win-probability. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. No host, home-ground, or altitude adjustments apply here; the prior reads straight from Elo.

Three-way split from the model: Croatia to win at 67%, the draw at 16%, and Ghana to win at 17%. The home side reads 67% on this distribution — the model's central case for Croatia.

On the same three-way, Kalshi: Croatia to win at 40%, the draw at 26%, and Ghana to win at 22%. Kalshi has Croatia at 40%, which prices out at American odds of +147; the model has the same side at 67%. The +27.0pp gap across them is the disagreement we're surfacing.

Bootstrap discipline matters most on the longshots — wide bands on small point estimates collapse the Pick rate fast. On Croatia the lower bound is 58%, which keeps the lower-bound gap at +17.8pp against the market — past +3pp, so the Pick clears. The Desk's posture is that calibration sits with the closing market across recent fixtures — we're not claiming the market is generally wrong, only that this side, on this fixture, looks mispriced. Selection is the dimension this verdict adds value on.

The number above is the most recent read; it isn't frozen. With kickoff roughly 36 days out, the model is on the weekly refresh cadence; we'll move to daily once we cross the T-5d window. Injury news, the actual XI, and weather conditions at kickoff all feed back into the prior when they land. We republish on every refresh. The Desk surfaces edge; what to do with that surface is a reader's call.
drivers: Pre-tournament Elo gives Croatia a stronger prior than the Kalshi line implies.
The +27.0pp gap clears our 3 percentage point threshold for a Pick.
Calibration sits with the closing market across recent fixtures, so selection is the lever.
Late-binding signals — form, confirmed XI, weather — re-evaluate closer to kickoff.
copy.summary: Croatia are favourites on the market at 40% — and the model thinks the market is still underrating them. Our prior reads 67%, a +27.0pp upgrade that crosses the Pick threshold comfortably.
copy.title: Croatia v Ghana · the model leans Croatia
